notes.title: Version 1.5.5 released
Version 1.5 released
notes.content:
New features

    Leaderboards
    Review mode after winning/losing a game
    Linux / SteamOS support
    MacOS: Apple Silicon support

Improvements

	Optimizations
	Solvable mode: added progress bar of level generation

Bug fix

	Sometimes click on a tile doesn't work

notes.title: Version 1.4 released
notes.content:
New features

    New game mode - "Solvable"


Improvements

    Optimizations
	Added option disable Question mark
        Added option on first click always open large area
	Added option remove tile pieces by timeout or automatically after fall (for slow PCs)

notes.title: Version 1.3 Released
notes.content:
New features

    Added possibility to cleanup numbers with key 'R'


Improvements

    Optimizations
    Level 11. When hiding columns, it is now easier to determine where the column stood


Bug fix

    When run a level and immediately exit, level music can overlap menu music

notes.title: Version 1.2 Released
notes.content:
New features

    Added control of the camera using the keyboard


Bug fix

    When using the joystick, when entering the pause menu, control may be lost

notes.title: Version 1.1 Released
notes.content:
Added languages

    French
    Italian
    German
    Spanish
    Chinese (trad.)
    Chinese (ex.)
    Portuguese
    Turkish
    Japanese


New features

    Framerate limited by 60


Bug fix

    In main menu, on item 15, wrong number of tiles 
    Impossible to get an achievement "Fan"
